posts.title: Last night
posts.description: The election was pretty exciting to watch and I know I was supposed to feel amazing, but I didn't. And it's not because I was rooting for the other team. Absolutely not. I can't explain it, but I felt... a lot of nothing. Why tho? I can't put my finger on it. Am I so cynical that I can't experience joy on the evening of what seems to be such a big deal? posts.description: Arts & Letters Daily linked to The Man Who Taught Us How to Pay Attention . It's yet another thing to go into my read-it-later app of the moment. It's a deep, dark hole of things I will never get to, but just in case... You know the drill. posts.title: A day of mourning for Dolly
posts.description: It's inconceivable that we have lost Dolly Parton. How beautiful that we lived in the time that she lived. There will never be another. There just couldn't be. I can't help but feel especially low about losing such an icon. I don't usually get emotional or think much of it when celebrities die. They're human after all. Her impact goes far beyond her music.
